### Short-Term Setbacks, Long-Term Gain
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/short-term-setbacks-long-term-gain
Passage: Ecclesiastes 9:17-18
Points:
- God's wisdom is guaranteed to prevail in the long run through Christ.
- In the near term, the loud shouting of foolish leaders can drown out quiet truth.
- Evil and sinners can inflict severe damage, but their victories are only temporary.
- Believers must keep an eternal perspective when following God brings hardship rather than immediate worldly success.

### Some “Above-the-Sun” Wisdom
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/some-above-the-sun-wisdom
Passage: Ecclesiastes 9:14-17
Points:
- Worldly might looks impressive, but wisdom is far more powerful and effective.
- Human nature frequently ignores, despises, or forgets wise counsel from humble sources.
- Fools gravitate toward the loud noise of worldly rulers over quiet, prudent advice.
- God's Spirit speaks softly to the heart, inviting believers to heed Scripture despite prevailing culture.
